name: ROI to ROI Tracking - MRTrix 0.2.12
summary: Tracks streamlines between pairs of ROIs with MRtrix 0.2 probabilistic CSD tractography (ensemble over lmax and curvature) and outputs a tractogram and classification.
description: Builds a white matter mask from FreeSurfer aparc+aseg (unless one is given), fits or reuses CSD, and runs MRtrix 0.2 streamtrack between each ROI pair in roiPair, then merges the tracks into a .tck and a white matter classification with surfaces for viewing. ROIs must match the DWI's dimensions unless reslice is set. Needs DWI, ROIs and FreeSurfer; CSD, brain mask and white matter mask are optional.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
The path to the ROIs datatype

aparc+aseg.nii.gz from freesurfer is used to create the white matter mask. You can override this by setting white_matter input, but you still need to input freesurfer as it is used to generate the visualization content (surface overlay)
The path to the csd datatype
The path to the mask datatype containing the brainmask of the DWI
Specify white matter mask you'd like to use - instead of creating one on the fly from the freesurfer input.

outputs.description: The classification structure including a classification.mat structure that contains the streamline indices in the tractogram.

parameters.description:
Max numb of params for CSD.
Leave empty if you know it.
This allows you to track multiple times the very same tract.

Space-separated pairing of 2 ROI numbers or ROI names you'd like to track between. For number "ROI" will be prefixed to search for the roi file (rois/ROI<num>.nii.gz). If not number, then the name is assumed to be rois/<name>.nii.gz

example: 
45 54
L_FEF_sphere_bin L_PIT_sphere_bin
maximum length of each streamline generated
minimum length of each streamline generated
maximum number of tracts to generate. if empty, mrtrix2 automatically sets to 100 times num_fibers
desired number of fibers per tracking output
Using a single (max) lmax instead of tracking with multiple lmax between 2 and max lmax.
If you want to use multiple rois for seeding, select true
reslice the input rois so that dimensions of them will match that of input dwi.
set the FA or FOD amplitude cutoff for terminating tracks.

failure_modes.cause: No streamlines were merged into a classification.
failure_modes.fix: Check roiPair names/numbers match files in the rois input and that ROIs match the DWI dimensions (or set reslice).
